verdict: Ads are running and converting — but leads aren't reaching your system yet.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, $1,045.48 in Google Ads spend produced 11 conversions recorded in the ad platform, yet zero leads are showing up in your CRM — the connection between the two is broken and is being repaired now. Google Business Profile activity also fell sharply this past week, with direction requests, calls, and site clicks all down while paid spend climbed 22.9% week-over-week. Several planned milestones — including your intake owner confirmation, the booking bot, and the Homer Glen branch page — passed their deadlines without completion, which is holding back the next phase of growth. We're focused on restoring the lead-tracking pipeline first so every conversion the ads are already producing starts counting in your system. Once that is confirmed, the scale-up gate and fall heating campaigns remain on track for October.
